title: Dialogue with Nestorius
blurb: A short dialogue, printed among the works of Cyril of Alexandria, in which Cyril and Nestorius trade Scripture verses over whether the Virgin Mary may be called God-bearer, whether the natures of Christ may be divided, and what the believer receives in the Eucharist. A fresh English translation from the Greek.
scope: The dialogue as printed in PG 76, cols. 249-253. The text here breaks off mid-sentence in Cyril's last reply, on the bread of life.

text_history.method: A fresh English translation made from the Greek text printed in PG 76 (Dialogus cum Nestorio). No published English version was used for its wording.
